title: Between the Bars
teaches: Fingerstyle piece. Benched: key and tuning disputed (Am shapes vs F♯m vs G minor; one tab tunes down a whole step) — settle it by ear first.

title: Angeles
teaches: Travis picking. Benched: sources disagree on tuning/capo and on the chords.

title: Independence Day
teaches: ♭VII, ♭VI and iv6 in C. Benched: no fetchable chart confirmed the chord names.

title: Miss Misery
teaches: 3/4 with Dm/F, Gm7add9, A7 and A♭. Benched: charts disagree on key and chord set.

title: Shine a Light
teaches: A 3/4 barre exercise (F – C – G); G as II in F gives a Lydian flavour. Both charts look like one transcription.

title: Dreaming
teaches: D–G riff; strumming stamina. Only one chart checked.

title: Strange Powers
teaches: Number-system piece: verse IV–I–V, chorus ii–iii7–vi–V–I in C. Chord names need a second source.

title: Blackbird
teaches: Tenths and an open-G-string pedal, with 3/4–2/4 meter changes. Note-level voicings not yet confirmed.

title: Julia
teaches: Fingerstyle, capo 2 with C-shapes (concert D). Chord shapes not reconciled.

title: Wild World
teaches: Circle of fifths Am–D7–G–Cmaj7–F–Dm–E (Cmaj7, D7, E as V). Chart verified; not from the early-era mix.

title: Teen Age Riot
teaches: Alternate tunings (GABDEG and GGDDGG); two interlocking guitars make a solo version a project of its own.

title: Space Oddity
teaches: Fmaj7/E, E7, B♭maj9–Am(add9)–G(add9)–F. A full chart was not cross-checked.

title: Hey! Luciani / Cruiser's Creek
teaches: Swaps to reduce the Neil Young count, if reliable charts turn up.
